name: Shadow Discharge
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: The shadow beacon's operation causes harmful energy to blast out of the base of the device.
disable:
DC 27 Crafting check or DC 27 Thievery check (master) to rig a dispersal system, or DC 27 Arcana check, DC 27 Nature check, DC 27 Occultism check, or DC 27 Religion check (master) to safely vent the magical energy; four total successes in any combination to disable

Special Disabling the shadow discharge does not disable the shadow beacon.
routine:
(1 action) The shadow beacon fires shadows into the sky, discharging excess energy out of the device's lower half. The trap deals 4d6 cold plus 4d6 void damage to all non-shadow creatures in a 60 foot emanation from the base of the device (DC 26 basic Fortitude save). For each successful check to disable the trap, the cold and void damage dealt by the trap on subsequent rounds are both reduced by 1d6 damage (see below). A creature that fails their save is pushed back 10 feet (15 feet on a critical failure).

3d6 cold plus 3d6 void

2d6 cold plus 2d6 void

1d6 cold plus 1d6 void

offensiveAbilities.name: Priming
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Nizca and Deg activate the shadow beacon

Effect The shadow beacon sparks to life. The trap then rolls initiative.
